gpg_home.description: Absolute path to GnuPG home directory; overrides $GNUPGHOME and --gnupghome.

crypto_policy_file.description: Absolute path to cryptographic policy configuration file.

options.description: List of configuration directives. Each item must specify 'name' and optionally 'type' and values depending on type. Supported types: flag (enabled), value (value), list (multiple values).

log_file.description: Path to write server mode logs. Enables --server mode logging.

default_key.description: Key ID or user ID to use as default for signing/decryption.

encrypt_to.description: List of user IDs to encrypt to in addition to intended recipients.

group_spec.description: Email alias group specification string for --group.

auto_key_locate.description: Colon-separated list of key location mechanisms for --auto-key-locate (e.g., 'node,ldap,wkd').

compression_level.description: Compression level for output (0 = disabled). Accepts integers 0-9.
